[[Containment]] |animations = 1 |voice = [https://www.roblox.com/users/31164652/profile#!/about Enthrallist] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|What more must I do to remove you from this realm?|audio = TheNightmareRealmWave17-1.ogg|'''???''' on Wave 17 of [[The Nightmare Realm]]}} }} ==Description== The '''Conserver''' was the main narrator of [[The Nightmare Realm]]. It also was the narrator for one wave in [[Containment]]. It had three variants. The first variant was its regular form, internally called '''Conserver''', which was [[Conserver]] from the [[Hexscape Event]]. The second variant was a sillhoute version of the first one, which was internally called '''HiddenConserver'''. This variant displayed the speaker as '''???'''. The third variant was the corrupted form, internally called '''CorruptedConserver''', which was [[Corrupted Conserver (Hexscape)|Corrupted Conserver]] from the [[Hexscape Event]]. This variant displayed the speaker as '''Corrupted Conserver''' speaker name. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Regular |The '''Conserver's''' body was made entirely out of what appears to be molten slag or lava. It wore black armor, which covered most of its body. Its helmet had multiple horns, additionally, it had spikes seen around its head that resembled teeth. On its back, it had the Artificial God Cube. It wielded a black club with neon red insides, which had three eyes on it. |Silhouette |The '''Conserver's''' body was entirely covered in darkness. It wore armor, which covered most of it body. Its helmet had multiple horns. Additionally, it had spikes seen around its head that resembled teeth. It wielded a black club with neon red insides, which had three eyes on it. |Corrupted |The '''Corrupted Conserver's''' body was made entirely out of what appears to be purple molten slag or lava. It wore black armor, which covered most of its body. Its helmet had multiple horns. Additionally, it had spikes seen around its head that resemble teeth. It wielded a black club with neon purple insides, which had three eyes on it. }} ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Conserver''' added. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Conserver''' removed. {{NarratorNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Conserver}}
